title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E12 — All Grown Up
Moesha and Hakeem reminisce about their friendship and wonder if it could be developing into something more.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E13 — Run, Mo, Run
An ex-con is after Moesha, and Dorian decides to search for his birth mother.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E14 — Mom
Dorian finds his mom, but it’s Moesha who ends up getting hurt.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E15 — That's My Mama
Dorian thought finding his mom would provide answers, not raise more questions (Lil Bow Wow guest stars).

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E16 — What If..
Niecy spins a fantasy about what Moesha’s life would be like if her mom raised her instead of Frank.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E17 — Scary Marriage
Moesha and her friends are matched up in a mock marriage for a homework assignment.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E10 — Air Cooper
When an advertising executive selects Mark to star in a commercial for athletic shoes, Mark misunderstands the part he is to play.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E11 — Santa's Got a Brand New Bag
Mark and Geneva are saddened when Nicole stops believing in Santa. Then a mysterious cousin visits, who knows how to make Nicole happy.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E15 — The Courtship of Mark Cooper
Mark is in the midst of defending himself in court when he realizes the plaintiff's lawyer is an ex-girlfriend he dumped brutally.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E18 — Trading Places
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E19 — Pros and Convicts
When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E12 — Katherine the Brave
Katherine takes over the role of scout leader for Webster's scout troop. Another male leader doesn't like the idea of a woman scout leader. When an injury calls for quick thinking, Katherine comes to the rescue.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E13 — What Price Friendship?
Webster tries to buy friendship to fit in with the two coolest kids in his school, Joey and David. George finds out he's supposed to speak at a ceremony for Gloria Steinem.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E1 — San Francisco: Part 1
Webster, Katherine and George help a musician (played by Lee Weaver) make his way to San Francisco to play with his old band at their 40th reunion show.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E2 — Katherine, the Greek
When George is a flop at predicting football games, he enlists the aid of Katherine, who proves to have an uncanny knack for picking winners.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E3 — Hello, Nicky
Webster helps his cousin Nicky, who's afraid to tell his family that he doesn't want to move to Nigeria with them.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E18 — Saving Private Rita
Moesha saves a suicidal friend, while Dorian pretends to be religious to impress a cute girl.
